text:
Tara Bloom: Quick postmortem follow-up: recurring pattern where long-prefix requests during autoscaling cause KV eviction cascades and occasional fallback to smaller model variants. We need a short actionable plan: owners, tests, and timelines for the next 2 weeks.

Ethan Wu: Agree. Minimal set: (A) regression replay of captured traces across scale events, (B) promptset that triggers eviction semantics (long prefix + token churn), (C) small load test stressing continuous batching, (D) one chaos drill simulating reduced GPU mem during warmup.

Sofia Ruiz: I can own the promptset + eval harness. Will create `tests/evals/promptsets/evict_long_context.yaml` with ~30 cases (short/long pairs, streaming/non-streaming). Add assertions for variant selection and token continuity. Target PR by EOW (2025-06-06).

Marcus Hale: I'll take the replay regression and CI job. Plan: build a replay runner that replays traces with timing preserved and a fast mode for local dev. Nightly run for 14 days against staging. Command: `./tools/replay --trace traces/scale_events/2025-05-30.json --speed 1x`. Goal: reproduce >90% of the scale-window requests within 20m.

Ethan Wu: Load test: small harness `tests/load/eviction_burst.py` scheduled nightly for 2 weeks, then move to weekly. Targets: p50 < 150ms, fallback_rate < 1%. I'll sketch the harness and drop it in CI.

Tara Bloom: Chaos drill: one-time run next quarter but we should do a targeted one sooner: simulate 30s of reduced GPU memory on staging during simulated scale-up. Marcus/Jordan from infra to coordinate. Marcus can trigger; Jordan to monitor.

Sofia Ruiz: Promptset snippet example:
```yaml
- id: evict_long_01
  input: "A" * 8000  # long prefix
  expect: contains("continued")
  assert_variant: not tiny
```
Will include negative cases too.

Marcus Hale: Ownership recap: Sofia -> promptset + eval harness (PR by EOW). Marcus -> replay runner + nightly CI (setup by Tue). Ethan -> load harness + CI job (by Tue). Tara -> coordinate chaos drill + playbook and schedule (draft by next Mon). ops-bot please create ticket and schedule a 30m sync.

ops-bot: Created ticket #INC-5021 "kv-eviction: replay + promptset + load + chaos" assigned to Tara Bloom, due 2025-06-20. Sync scheduled: 2025-06-09 16:00 UTC.

Ethan Wu: Implementation notes: replay should preserve inter-request timing and allow a small jitter parameter. Fast local run: `python -m repro.replay traces/scale_events/2025-05-30.json --fast --jitter 0.1`. CI job should fail fast on fallback_rate > 1%.

Sofia Ruiz: I'll add an eval expectation: `assert fallback_rate < 0.01` and a lightweight mock model so CI is stable. PR will reference the incident logs.

Marcus Hale: Dashboard panels to add: nightly_replay/pass_rate, fallback_rate, eviction_rate, model_variant_switches. I'll wire alert: post to #eng-oncall if nightly fails 2x.

Tara Bloom: Timeline check: PRs by EOW, CI + dashboards by Tue, chaos playbook draft by next Mon, chaos run after 3 consecutive green nights. If anyone can't meet deadlines, call it out here.

Ethan Wu: +1 on alerts. Also recommend adding a gating rule for model swaps: last 7 nights green before swap. We can discuss in sync.

Sofia Ruiz: PR opened draft: https://github.com/redwood/repro/pull/812 (includes promptset + eval harness).

Marcus Hale: I'll create CI job `ci/jobs/eviction_replay.yml` and link traces in the ticket.

Tara Bloom: Thanks all. We'll review progress in the scheduled sync and close INC-5021 once tasks are in progress. :thumbsup:
